Fields.Name: Event
Fields.Description: The event that triggers this transition.

Fields.Name: To State
Fields.Description: The state this transition goes to, in the same state machine.

Fields.Name: Trigger Interval
Fields.Description: When the transition can be started by its event, if the Use Trigger Interval flag is set.

Fields.Name: Initiate Interval
Fields.Description: When the transition can begin once triggered, if the Use Initiate Interval flag is set.

Fields.Name: Transition Effect
Fields.Description: How the old state blends into the new one. None: switch at once.

Fields.Name: Condition
Fields.Description: A condition that must hold for the transition to start, or that starts it without an event.

Fields.Name: From Nested State
Fields.Description: With the From Nested State flag, the state of the nested state machine the transition must come from.

Fields.Name: To Nested State
Fields.Description: With the To Nested State flag, the state of the target's nested state machine to go to.

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Which transition wins when several could start from the same event: the highest.

Fields.Name: Transition Flags
Fields.Description: Transition options: use trigger / initiate intervals, uninterruptible while playing or delayed, delay state change, disabled, disallow return to previous state or random transition, disable condition, allow self transition from any state, global / local wildcard, from / to nested state ID valid, abut at end of from generator.
